verdict.rationale: Browser Use documents its own parallel-execution capacity: 10 concurrent cloud browsers by default, scaling to 50, 250, 500 or 1,000 with spend, and it pitches the library for automating the web 'at scale'. Its example tasks also span many items, such as extracting all followers to a CSV. However, there is no documented batch or bulk endpoint, so fanning work out across many items appears to require looping over runs.create in your own code. missing for 10: a first-party batch/bulk operation API or feature, docs describing how to run one task over many items, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk runs at scale.
